name: merch-table
description: A band's own merch store: static pages on your own domain, a cart, Stripe Checkout, free hosting. No platform, no rent, no tracking.

STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.description: Your Stripe **Secret key**: Stripe → Developers → API keys → Secret key → **Reveal**. It starts with `sk_test_`. Not the Publishable key (`pk_…`), which is the one Stripe shows first.

ADMIN_KEY.description: A password for your store's admin. Make up something long. You type it once per phone or laptop to sign in at `/admin`.

OWNER_EMAIL.description: Your email. It becomes the store's contact address (you can change it in the admin) and lets you sign in by email later.

STOCK.description: Where your edits, orders and stock counts are kept. Created for you; nothing to do.
